$comment: Classification of every emission of protocol/openclaw/2026.10.33/agent-emissions.json — meta-schema: protocol/emissions.schema.json; ratchet: test/emissions-coverage.test.ts. Each (stream, phase) pair, each data key an emitter writes, and each key a gateway rewrite adds is handled (anchor + verified proof), ignored (a deliberate exclusion, said why) or a gap (its écart identifier and impact). A new version starts from the previous registry; the ratchet lists what its inventory added or dropped. 2026.10.33: carried forward from 2026.9.36. A golden-corpus proof names the 2026.10.33 capture that shows the pair or key (the corpus promoted from the bench run that validated this tag). One stream, five (stream, phase) pairs and forty data keys are new; two pairs and two keys left.
